text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #52514e

g.text: All vessels solved together in one ConcurrentVessel (1109 states, AssimuloBackend), flows at t = 16 h. Card contents in g/s. Classes read from the solved objects.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: A1 The solid F that D01H passes on as slurry dissolves quickly and completely in R02R's liquid, then reacts.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: R02R has no solid phase, so the D01H -> R02R link turns crystal mass into dissolved F, conserving mass.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: A2 F01H, F02H, F01R and F02R are steady-state splits evaluated inside the links (ContinuousFilter settings, no

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: holdup), not vessels. F02H and F02R use the settings of F01H and F01R.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: A3 The solubility S0 of D02H and D01H is fixed at CR02H's design mother liquor (Flowsheet.CAKE_LIQUID_DESIGN).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: A4 R02R's outlet is all liquid. D, E and J would start to come out of solution in R02R, but the model assumes

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: no solids form there; all crystallization happens in D01R.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: A5 W02H and W02R are each two unit ops, a dissolver vessel (D02H, D02R) and a filter link (F02H, F02R), drawn

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: A6 D02R's crystals pass through unchanged (no nucleation, growth or dissolution): in ~55 mol/L B, c_sat ~1e-7

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: mol/L, so the wash could dissolve ~5e-11 mol/s at most, and its liquor stays undersaturated.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #c62f2f
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Trebuchet MS', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0b0b0b

g.text: W1 CR01H crystallizes 0.286 g/s of F (80% of its F); it should stay liquid.
